form.narrative: Hit a stationary truck while reversing in a parking lot. The owner was ferrying paying passengers through a mobile app at the time.

photo.description: The front bumper of the vehicle has a noticeable dent.
photo.summary: This image shows a close-up view of the front bumper of a white car. The bumper has a noticeable dent on the right side. The car's license plate is visible on the left side of the bumper. There is a small yellow sticker with some text on the bumper, located towards the center-left. The car's headlight and part of the wheel are also visible in the image. The background shows a blurred outdoor setting with some greenery.
